text:
alana: EdgeWave QA surfaced failures during our integration smoke for their marketplace image. It looks like a kernel-ABI / driver mix: our runtime hits unresolved symbols on some kernels. Can we run a short alignment?
praveen: link to logs?
edgewave-pm: https://edgewave.status/runs/221 - error shows undefined symbols from amdgpu module on 6.2.x hosts and libcublas mismatches on CUDA hosts (12.1 vs 12.2).
lio: sounds like their packagers built modules against newer headers. Kernel module build-id mismatch causes kmod symbol errors. We should offer a "kernel-abi bridge" artifact: vendor-signed modules that match the marketplace kernel + a pinned-driver deb for SIs.
noa: agree. Also recommend publishing a short compatibility manifest consumed by their image builder so the marketplace listing can advertise tested combos. Example manifest fields to include in README: 
```nvidia_driver: "535.86.05"
cuda_compat: "12.2 tested, 12.1-compatible runtime available"
rocm_bundle: "5.3.2-tested"
kernel_tested: "5.15.78, 6.1.9, 6.2.14"
module_build_ids: ["amdgpu-1a2b3c","amdgpu-4d5e6f"]
```
alana: EdgeWave also needs an air-gapped plan for SI partners (they install via TandemSI). TandemSI wants exact debs and a checksum manifest.
praveen: I'll build the pinned driver deb and a GPG signed manifest. Upload location: gs://edgewave-partner/bundles/abi-bridge/. I'll need upload perms.
marketplace-team: granted temporary write to edgewave-partner/bundles/abi-bridge/ until 4735000000.
lio: for partners running mixed kernels we should provide a small helper: a signed kernel module tarball plus a script to insert modules with correct order (headers -> modules -> driver). Also include `modinfo` output and module GPG sigs.
noa: runtime-side guard: implement a boot-time probe that detects kmod symbol mismatch or nvml/rocminfo init failure. If detected, log a concise remediation hint with the artifact link and flip to cpu-quantized fallback after two retries. That reduces customer impact.
edgewave-pm: we can freeze GA for 48h if you need it. Willing to delay announcement.
alana: propose timeline: 1) praveen builds pinned deb + signed checksums by 09:00 PT tomorrow, 2) lio prepares kernel-module tar + install script by 11:00 PT, 3) noa lands runtime guard + telemetry tag driver_bundle=edgewave-abi-bridge by 16:00 PT, 4) marketplace manifest updated by 18:00 PT.
praveen: sample deb upload script I'll use:
```#!/bin/bash
set -e
f=edgewave-driver-535.86.05.deb
gpg --output ${f}.sig --detach-sign $f
sha256sum $f > checksums.txt
gsutil cp $f ${f}.sig checksums.txt gs://edgewave-partner/bundles/abi-bridge/
```
lio: smoke/check commands for module verification:
```
sudo modinfo amdgpu | head -n 20
/opt/rocm/bin/rocminfo || true
dmesg | tail -n 100 | grep -i "amdgpu\|killed module\|unsatisfied" || true
./redwood-smoke --backend rocm --model embed-64 --tokens 128
```
noa: telemetry: add fields `driver_bundle=edgewave-abi-bridge`, `detected_kernel_build=<build-id>`, and `kmod_mismatch=true` for easy querying.
ops-bot: ticket EDGE-210 created: edgewave-abi-bridge-validation. Linked logs: edgewave.status/runs/221.
alana: action items summary:
- praveen: pinned driver deb + signed checksums + upload (due 4732104800)
- lio: kernel-module tar + install script + smoke checklist (due 4732106000)
- noa: runtime guard + telemetry tag (due 4732109600)
- marketplace-team: update manifest + README (due 4732110000)
edgewave-pm: we'll pause GA for 48h and coordinate on the comms blurb.
praveen: :thumbsup:
lio: :thumbsup:
noa: :thumbsup:
marketplace-team: :thumbsup:
alana: if the ABI bridge doesn't resolve failures, we'll escalate to the hardware vendor with bisect artifacts and core dumps. Keep this channel as the primary coordination thread.
edgewave-pm: thanks, holding GA and will wait for go/no-go. Please post status updates here as milestones complete.
